authority: Principal delegated all reasonable theory decisions through run completion. These are counted model/preparation choices, not measurements or native derivations.

shared_state.b: One common positive b=beta_native*Ud for DDO154 and NGC3198; jointly independently calibrated with native ratios and dimensional scales, then frozen. No value chosen here.
shared_state.scope: Counted universal effective-equilibrium/environment hypothesis; not inferred from baryonic gas temperature. Expanded per-galaxy b remains a separate sensitivity family and cannot inherit a target b constraint from DDO154.

stellar.radial: Existing actual face-on intensity nodes, piecewise-linear intensity, reference M/L3.6=0.5 and0.4/0.6 population alternatives. Constant first-node core; continuous exponential outer tail with the saved photometric Rd. These extrapolations are explicit model assumptions, not observed exterior bounds.
stellar.vertical: rho_star(z)=Sigma_star/(4*h_star)*sech(z/(2*h_star))^2 in proper vertical distance; h_star=Rd/7.3. This chosen isothermal shape matches the primary printed Sigma=4*rho0*h convention.
stellar.height_scope: 7.3 plus/minus2.2 is a population flattening relation, not measured galaxy height or confidence coverage. Ratios5.1/9.5 and flagged photometry are explicit source sensitivities.
stellar.supersedes: Earlier .196*(Rd/kpc)^.633 height formula remains preserved as an optional named alternative, not the primary height relation.

atomic_gas.closure: Counted finite-support polytropic preparation; P=K*rho^Gamma; epsilon=rho*c^2+P/(Gamma-1).
atomic_gas.dispersion_scope: Primary Leroy AppendixB adopts11km/s;11+/-3 describes lower-inclination outer THINGS disks. Here it is a source-motivated preparation assumption, not an individual sigma_z measurement or confidence interval for either high-inclination galaxy.
atomic_gas.boundary: Solve the actual free boundary P=0 jointly with the metric. For a static lapse with asymptotic limit, strict ln(N_infinity/N0)>ln(1+h0/c^2) is necessary for finite support; no arbitrary numerical height cutoff can replace failed confinement.
atomic_gas.rotation: For circular flow with Omega constant along a column and no shift, replace N by Nrot=sqrt(N^2-Omega^2*R^2/c^2), only while timelike and with the actual proper circumferential R. Otherwise integrate the full vertical Euler equation; N-only is a declared leading weak-field approximation, not exact rotating equilibrium.
atomic_gas.source: Use the actual nonnegative complete-annulus mean inputs, helium already included once. NGC3198 all51 complete means were checked nonnegative, so no negative-mean clipping is required. Retain signed pixel and partial-support ledgers.

molecular_gas.NGC3198: Ten actual Leroy H2 rings at S1_alternative_and_stellar_median_rows/rows/0..9/components/H2 in NGC3198_MAIN_SOURCE_ANNULAR_INPUT_V001.json; already converted including helium, no extra1.36. Subsequent13 entries are missing.
molecular_gas.vertical_reference: Same normalized stellar-height tracer profile, explicitly counted source-shape assumption; the HI polytropic profile is a separate shape alternative. Neither is a measured molecular hydrostatic state.
molecular_gas.missing: DDO154 blank H2 and outer NGC3198 missing H2 remain unmeasured. Zero extra unmeasured H2 is only a named restricted reference approximation, never a nondetection bound.

uncertainty_limits: Masked HI, unknown exterior mass and missing H2 have no finite empirical bounds in the available sources. Preserve the general nonnegative nuisance family; do not report uncertainty of the restricted reference as exhaustive. State/source sensitivity belongs inside the campaign and does not authorize target-selected membership.
remaining_execution: Provider evaluation, coupled gas/metric solve, independent calibration and joint region freeze remain undone. No numerical 43-point prediction or scoring occurred.
